criteria.requirement: Implement deepdiff.merge.deep_merge(left,right,*,lists="replace",conflicts="right"), MergeConflict(path), validate_json_tree and actual-DeepDiff-based json_equal. Recursively union dict keys preserving left then right order; lists explicitly replace or append with duplicate preservation; conflicting leaves/types choose right/left or raise at exact tuple path. Preserve bool-vs-int and None semantics, input independence, reject nonstring dict keys, unsupported objects, nonfinite floats and cycles while allowing acyclic shared references. Do not change Delta or merge arbitrary object attributes; prove native Delta still performs target replacement.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
